reason: The public presentation is coherent, legible and unusually clear about the no-fee, semester-long offer. Desktop and mobile captures preserve the Precision Instrument hierarchy. I traced the client Work → engagement FAQ → Contact journey in source and inspected its passing intercepted browser checks; this is not observed client success. Public canonicals, complete social metadata, private noindex defaults and request-time case/social rendering are thoughtfully implemented. The prior recruitment failure objection is resolved in current source: unavailable, no-cycle and successfully empty events receive distinct wording and appropriate actions, with actual SSR assertions and passing logs. Nevertheless, the two primary audiences still lack important decision evidence: clients cannot inspect an approved example of MECG work, and students cannot establish membership schedule fit. Truthful disclosures mitigate misleading claims but do not complete these information tasks. Those concrete gaps prevent my agreement with the broad world-class claim. Release readiness remains unproven because consequential hosted integrations and operator acceptance are outside the supplied local evidence.

findings.evidence: The approved fallback remains empty; organization profiles explicitly withhold scope, methods, deliverables and outcomes. The actual supplied homepage captures show partnerships and pending approval rather than an engagement example. The corrected heading is truthful, so the former unsupported-heading issue is not repeated.
findings.userImpact: A prospective organization cannot inspect the contribution, reasoning or usefulness of comparable MECG work before investing in an inquiry.
findings.suggestedFix: Have content owners obtain client and Board approval for one real question, methods, redacted handoff artifact and bounded result or limitations; publish through the existing approval boundary. Retain pending copy until approved.

findings.evidence: The weekly-commitment FAQ explicitly says expected hours, mandatory meeting times and peak commitments are unpublished. The direct Board email is a useful verified mitigation, but supplies no planning facts.
findings.userImpact: Students must initiate a separate conversation to determine whether membership fits their semester, even after finding the relevant FAQ.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain and publish a dated, current-cycle Board-approved typical weekly range, fixed obligations and peak-week caveat beside preparation. Do not invent estimates.

notVerified: Actual hosted Clerk sessions, Supabase RPC/RLS, uploads/storage, email delivery, provisioning and consequential operator recovery; no staging exists.
Observed human comprehension/task success, complete authenticated keyboard journeys, assistive technology, physical iPhone or macOS Safari.
Client publication approval, current workload facts and Board privacy/retention/remediation decisions.

Publication script was inspected but not run; its reported synthetic proof does not establish hosted withdrawal or third-party social-cache invalidation. Private visual craft beyond supplied evidence was not assessed.
